title: fix(lint)!: page/view visibleWhen refuses a has() argument that is not a field selection
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg52sU6eSQpjfDKQEaQYrvSX)_

Fixes #25281

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed

Executes ruling `6351260886` on #25281, letter A. Draft until the maintainer ratifies that ruling; the seat runs the contract review and the landing.

## What

CEL defines `has()` in one form, `has(e.f)`, with `f` a field name after a dot. The engine refuses any other argument as `has() invalid argument` on every evaluation, whatever the record holds. The page and view `visibleWhen` door (`validateVisibilityPredicates`, so `os validate`, `os build`, `os lint`, `defineStack` and the page and view save doors) did not judge the argument, so `has(status)` and `has(record.items[0])` published clean and the console drew the guarded element for every user.

- **`@objectstack/lint`**: a new gating arm, `visibility-predicate-has-argument` (`error`), in the existing family, at the same site and path as its siblings. It fires on a `has()` call whose single argument is not a `.` field selection, reports the first such call per predicate, quotes the argument and the engine's wording, and gives one hint line with the spelling the definition admits:
  - a bare name: `has(record.status)` or `'status' in record`, with the root the layer binds (`data` on a metadata-editing form); a bare root (`has(record)`) is told `has(record.FIELD)`, never `record.record`;
  - an index as the last step: `size(record.items) > 0`, or `'k' in e` when the index is a string key;
  - `e.?f`: `has(e.f)`; anything else: the one form, with the layer root.
  
  No null-guard advice is repeated (`validate-null-guards` owns it). `os explain visibility-predicate-has-argument` carries the reasoning.
- **The oracle (mechanism (b) of the ruling)**: the canonical AST this rule already walks for the #16118 mask. A `has` call with exactly one argument whose node is not `.` is refused. After `rewriteIndexedHas` (#25267) the engine refuses exactly those arguments, and the suite pins the equivalence against `celEngine.compile` in both directions: 22 refused shapes and 10 accepted shapes. Mechanism (b) was chosen over (a) because the engine reports one error per source: in `bogusFn(1) && has(status)` a compile-based helper would see only the unknown function, while the AST walk sees the `has()` call too.
- **The #16118 mask stays load-bearing.** `has(status)` alone yields ONE finding (this one). `has(status) && status == 'x'` keeps its `visibility-bare-identifier` finding on the unguarded `status`, beside the new one.
- **`@objectstack/spec`, ADR-0087 kit**: the D3 semantic entry `visibility-predicate-has-argument-refused` (step 18) and a `REFUSED_STORED_SHAPES` detector. `os migrate meta --stored` lists a stored page component, form section or section field carrying the shape under that id. No D2 conversion: the test the author meant is not recorded. `packages/spec` cannot parse CEL, so the detector reads the source through a package-internal token reading (`conversions/cel-has-argument.ts`). A lint-side test (`validate-visibility-predicates.stored-listing.test.ts`) holds the listing, the page save door and `celEngine.compile` to one set over 29 predicates.
- **`@objectstack/formula`**: comment only. The STILL OPEN note above `firstUndeclaredReference` records that the page/view door now reports the argument. The first-error masking it describes is unchanged.

## Pins rewritten as part of the ruling (not silently)

- The module note: the rule list (five gating rules), §Function existence point 2 ("narrows by exactly TWO axes"), the CEL-TYPE blind-spot bullet ("Function existence and the `has()` argument shape excepted"), and a new §`has()` argument shape that quotes the ruling and states what it does not change.
- `validate-visibility-predicates.test.ts`: row 3 (`has(status)` alone), "several bare `has()` arguments" and the comprehension row flip from `[]` to the one `has()` finding, with no bare-identifier finding. The "#13594 narrows this pin by exactly one axis" block becomes two axes and adds `has(status)` beside `totallyBogusFn(1,2)`.

## Unchanged (#13594's scope discipline, verbatim)

`has(e.f)` for any `e`, including the indexed and call receivers #25267 lowers; every `dyn` predicate; `type == 'grid'`, `type(record.x) == string`, `upper(1, 2)`, `1 + 'a'` (pinned: no `has()` finding); a `has(` inside a string literal; a member call `x.has(y)`; `has()` and `has(a, b)`, which the engine refuses under another message; the render-side fail-open (ADR-0137 D3).

## Measured before the first edit

- HotCRM producers: **0** at `4166f21` (shallow clone). The 550 `has(` occurrences hold no bare-name and no index-last argument in a CEL string. The only hits are comment prose (`(!has(x) || isBlank(x))` in two flow docblocks, one test comment).
- This repository: **0** at the base `5801a4f`. Every `has(NAME)` / `has(e[i])` hit is TypeScript `Map`/`Set` `.has(`, a code comment, CHANGELOG or docs prose.
- Base `5801a4f`: `has(status)` and `has(record.items[0])` on a form field draw no finding from `validateVisibilityPredicates`, and `celEngine.compile` answers `has() invalid argument` on both. The suite at the base pinned that silence (rows 898–926).

## Tests

Run on this branch, each under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`:

- Before the merge of `main` (head `ce74b8efc`): `@objectstack/lint` 154 files / 7164 tests, `@objectstack/formula` 52 / 1376, `@objectstack/spec` 710 / 21577 (1 todo), all passing; the three packages type-check.
- After merging `main` (#25299, head `7f0e0e6fe`): `@objectstack/spec` `src/conversions` + `src/migrations` 26 files / 1036 tests, `@objectstack/lint` 154 / 7164, both passing; spec and lint type-check. The merge kept both refused-shape describes; the new detector reads the stack alone and does not use the context parameter #25279 added.
- New suites: `validate-visibility-predicates.test.ts` › `visibility-predicate-has-argument (#25281)` (acceptance pair, engine equivalence both ways, prescriptions, mask, first-only, boundaries, carriers); `validate-visibility-predicates.stored-listing.test.ts` (engine, page door and stored listing over 18 refused + 11 accepted predicates); `conversions/cel-has-argument.test.ts`; the `#25281` describe in `refused-shapes.test.ts`; two rows and a view-door assertion in `runtime-gate.page-visibility-predicate-writes.test.ts`.

## Gates

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 92 families, the same list before and after the merge. On head `7f0e0e6fe` all 92 were run and each exited 0; `--ran` reconciliation: "92 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 92 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". This includes `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration` and `check-changeset-no-major`. (On the pre-merge head `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 for a missing dist; with the dists built it exits 0.)

## Dogfood battery

`pnpm exec turbo run build --filter='@objectstack/dogfood^...' && pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test` on head `7f0e0e6fe`: 289 files passed, 3 skipped (292); 2491 tests passed, 18 skipped (2509). `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

## Acceptance notes

- The detector in `packages/spec` reads tokens, not the engine's AST. A predicate that is also broken CEL can be listed there while the door names its syntax fault first. Both send the owner to the same predicate.
- Not addressed here: on the object, flow, action, sharing-rule and hook surfaces, `validateExpression` already refuses both shapes (`invalid-cel`, `has() invalid argument`). Its prescription there is the generic "predicates are bare CEL", not a `has()` spelling. Noted, not filed: the verdict is right and the surface is outside this card.
